title: fix(storage): upload links refuse a locked record or a read-only field instead of a false "attached"
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuQGmZTsbYRnd2fzW7f7Aw8T)_

Fixes #32734

The other half of the card's first expectation, judging a `readonlyWhen` field when the link is issued, is carried by #32768: the engine offers no judgement a door can ask without writing. Here that case is judged when the link is used.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：代理用 `create_upload_link` 给用户发上传链接时，记录正在审批中被锁定、或字段声明了 `readonly`，现在不再签发链接，而是直接说明原因；链接发出后字段才变成只读（`readonlyWhen`）或记录才被锁定，用户上传时会看到带原因的拒绝（403 / 409），已上传的文件不保留；上传页只有在服务器回答里带了文件 id 时才显示「已附上」。
- 为什么改：之前锁定记录的上传只回答 500「Upload failed」，没有原因；`readonlyWhen` 生效后上传页仍显示「Done. The file was attached」，其实字段没有变，文件还留在存储里。
- 风险与回滚：只收紧上传链接这一扇门（签发时多两项检查，写字段改为严格写，拒绝时删掉刚存的文件），不新增权限规则，附件列表链接（`attachments: true`）行为不变；错误码账本给已有的 `RECORD_LOCKED` 记一个新的发出包。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/services/service-storage/src/record-file-access.ts`（签发时的两项检查、`strictReadonlyWrites` 与 `readonlyRefusalOf`）、`storage-routes.ts`（`relayUploadLinkRefusal` 改读 `statusCode`）、`upload-link-page.ts`（「已附上」的判定）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-storage exec vitest run src/record-file-access.integration.test.ts -t "#32734"`，预期 5 passed。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。
- 席位意见：契约复审 PASS（记录 6830676963，钉 `5bd8b5dc`）；一条 should-fix（工具说明只对字段目标成立）与两条 nit 按项目规则转跟进卡 #32783，页面措辞那条记到 #32712；签发时判 `readonlyWhen` 由 #32768 承接。

## What changes

`@objectstack/service-storage` (the fix), `@objectstack/mcp` (one sentence of the tool's description) and `@objectstack/spec` (one error-code ledger row). No new error code, wire field, permission rule or export.

- **Minting a field link (`createUploadLinkAs`).** After the existing parent-edit and field-writability checks, two more refusals for a file field:
  - the field's own `readonly: true` declaration: `403 FIELD_NOT_ACCESSIBLE`, "the field is read-only" (the update strips such a field from every user's write, so a link to it could never attach anything);
  - a record a pending approval locks: `409 RECORD_LOCKED`, asked of `IApprovalService.getRecordLock(object, recordId, caller)`, the same judgement the approvals plugin's record-lock hook enforces on every edit. No lock check is re-implemented in storage; with no approvals service registered, nothing is asked and the hook still refuses on use. The plugin passes the service in through a new optional `getApprovals` dep.
- **Using a field link (`fillFieldThroughLink`).** The record update now runs with `strictReadonlyWrites: true`, so a field the engine would strip (`readonly`, or a `readonlyWhen` that holds now) refuses the whole write with `ERR_READONLY_FIELD_REJECTED` instead of answering success with the field unchanged. `readonlyRefusalOf` turns that into the link's `403 FIELD_NOT_ACCESSIBLE`, with a reason that starts "Nothing was attached:" and names the field (the engine's own message speaks to a developer about write options). The stored upload is discarded on every failed write, as before.
- **The route's relay (`relayUploadLinkRefusal`).** It read a declared status from `status` only. The record-lock hook declares `statusCode` (`409 RECORD_LOCKED`), so a link minted before the lock answered `500 INTERNAL "Upload failed"`. It now reads `resolveThrownHttpError(err).declaredStatus` (`status`, then `statusCode`, then the validation shape), the reading `/api/v1/data` already uses for the same code.
- **The page (`upload-link-page.ts`).** "Done. The file was attached" only when the answer is `success: true` and carries `data.fileId`; any other answer shows the refusal's own message, or "The upload failed." when there is none.
- **The ledger (`error-code-ledger.zod.ts`).** `RECORD_LOCKED` added to the `@objectstack/service-storage` row: a second emitter of the code `@objectstack/plugin-approvals` registers, provenance, not identity.
- **The tool description (`mcp-http-tools.ts`).** `create_upload_link` now says that a locked record or a read-only field gets no link, and that an upload the field cannot take is refused with the reason. No ruling-annotated line around it moved.

## Why

Measured before the fix, on this branch with each piece put back (the ablations below are the same readings):

- a link minted before the record was locked: `500 {"success":false,"error":{"code":"INTERNAL","message":"Upload failed"}}`;
- a link minted on a draft whose `readonlyWhen` then held: `200 {"success":true,"data":{"fileId":"…","size":11,"field":"invoices"}}`, the record's `invoices` unchanged and the stored `sys_file` left behind; the page then said "Done. The file was attached";
- a link to a locked record or a `readonly` field was issued with no refusal.

## Tests

`packages/services/service-storage/src/record-file-access.integration.test.ts`, new describe `#32734 — a field the write cannot change: no link, and never "attached"`, on the real engine with the storage plugin's hooks, an approvals stub whose `getRecordLock` reads the record as the caller, and a `beforeUpdate` hook that throws `RECORD_LOCKED` with `statusCode: 409` as the approvals plugin's does:

1. minting refuses a `readonly` field `403 FIELD_NOT_ACCESSIBLE`, and writes no link row;
2. minting refuses a locked record `409 RECORD_LOCKED`, and writes no link row; once unlocked, it mints;
3. a draft takes the upload; once its `readonlyWhen` holds, an upload through a link minted before is refused `403`, message `^Nothing was attached: `, `invoices` unchanged, no `sys_file` with the upload's name, the link row gone;
4. a record locked after the link was minted refuses the upload `409 RECORD_LOCKED`, not 500, keeping nothing;
5. the page script, run in `node:vm` against stubbed answers: "Done" only with a `fileId`; `{success:true,data:{}}` shows "The upload failed."; a refusal shows its message.

`packages/qa/dogfood/test/showcase-mcp-record-files.dogfood.test.ts`, new describe `[#32734] a field read-only when the upload arrives (readonlyWhen)`, on the real stack: a member's claim object with `invoices` (`readonlyWhen: "record.status == 'approved'"`); a link minted over MCP on the draft uploads `200`; a second link minted before the claim is approved is refused `403 FIELD_NOT_ACCESSIBLE` with "Nothing was attached:" naming `dogfood_upload_claim.invoices`, `invoices` unchanged, no `sys_file` for the second file, and the spent link answers `404`.

```

    × minting refuses a readonly field 403 FIELD_NOT_ACCESSIBLE, and writes no link
    AssertionError: expected null to match object { code: 'FIELD_NOT_ACCESSIBLE', …(1) }
    blob after restore f190f961 == HEAD

A2  getRecordLock check at mint removed
    × minting refuses a record a pending approval locks 409 RECORD_LOCKED and writes no link; once unlocked, it mints
    AssertionError: expected null to match object { code: 'RECORD_LOCKED', status: 409 }
    blob after restore f190f961 == HEAD

A3  strictReadonlyWrites removed from the field write
    × a draft takes the upload; once its readonlyWhen holds, ... refused 403 with the reason, attaching and keeping nothing
    AssertionError: {"success":true,"data":{"fileId":"09494766-…","size":11,"field":"invoices"}}: expected 200 to be 403
    blob after restore f190f961 == HEAD

A4  relay reads `status` only (the old reading)
    × a record locked after the link was minted refuses the upload 409 RECORD_LOCKED, not 500, keeping nothing
    AssertionError: {"success":false,"error":{"code":"INTERNAL","message":"Upload failed"}}: expected 500 to be 409
    blob after restore f9fcc8dc == HEAD

A5  page back to `if(r.ok){ ... attached ... }`
    × the page says attached only for an answer naming the stored file; a refusal shows its reason
    Expected: "The upload failed."  Received: "Done. The file was attached; you can close this page."
    blob after restore e0fd294d == HEAD

Dogfood  A3 through dist (--hold, build, ablation-dist-preflight --absent exit 0, run)
    × a draft takes the upload; after approval a link minted before is refused 403 with the reason, attaching and keeping nothing
    AssertionError: {"success":true,"data":{"fileId":"2032193e-…","size":587,"field":"invoices"}}: expected 200 to be 403
    restored, rebuilt, ablation-dist-preflight (restored) exit 0, tree clean
```

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Issue-time `readonlyWhen` is #32768's.** A link is still issued for a field whose `readonlyWhen` holds when it is minted; the upload through it is then refused with the reason and attaches nothing (test 3 and the dogfood pin). No `packages/objectql` change here.
- **Attachment links are unchanged.** The lock check is in the file-field branch only: an attachment is a `sys_attachment` insert, which the record lock does not refuse, so `attachments: true` mints and attaches under a lock as before. The attach-rights questions (`assertMayAttach`, `mayEditAttachmentParent`, the field-writability list) are untouched, so the behaviour #32754 reports (a member refused `attachments: true` on their own record) is the same before and after this change: read from the diff, not measured live.
- **The relay now also serves the validation shape's 400.** A validation failure thrown by the field write (`code: 'VALIDATION_FAILED'`, no `status`) answered 500 before; it now answers its declared 400 with its message, the same one-spelling defect class (read from `resolveThrownHttpError`, not pinned here). A throw with no string `code` (an unevaluable hook condition, a plain `Error`) still answers 500, as before.
- **Ordering of the strict refusal.** The engine judges `strictReadonlyWrites` after the `beforeUpdate` hooks and before the driver write, so a lock refuses first (`409`) and a holding `readonlyWhen` reaches the strict refusal (`403`). Copy-on-claim in `beforeUpdate` copies only a file another record owns; the link's file is unowned and the field's existing ids are this record's own, so the refused write mints no copy (read from the code; the pins count `sys_file` rows by the upload's name).
- **`RECORD_LOCKED` in the storage ledger row** is a new emitter of an existing code, not a new code: `check:api-surface` reads no change, so `Clause-②: no` (the door only refuses links it used to issue).
- **Branch name.** The thread's designated branch `claude/project-thread-4bhuy8`, not `claude/issue-32734-*`; the claim's `Branch:` line was amended to name it.
